title: Lecture Indexer
description: Google Cloud services and Azure backup storage, on one page.

options.content: Flat or empty charts are expected while the environment is paused (`make cloud-pause`). Azure storage charts can lag a backup by several hours.

panels.title: Database
panels.description: Built-in metric. Cloud SQL reported up in its latest minute of the last 5 minutes. Goes Down within about 5 minutes of it stopping.

panels.title: Backups
panels.description: Log-based metric. At least one backup succeeded in the last 26 hours.

panels.title: Frontend
panels.description: Uptime check, every 5 minutes. The uptime check reached Cloud Run.

panels.title: Load balancer
panels.description: Uptime check, every 5 minutes. The uptime check reached the load balancer. This does not test the API pods.

panels.title: Ingest pods
panels.description: Built-in metric. At least one ingest pod reported in the last 3 minutes. Goes Down within about 3 minutes of the pods stopping. A crash-looping pod can still count.

panels.title: Search pods
panels.description: Built-in metric. At least one search pod reported in the last 3 minutes. Goes Down within about 3 minutes of the pods stopping. A crash-looping pod can still count.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Includes the uptime check.

panels.title: Response time, p95
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. 95% of requests were faster than this.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Includes the uptime check, and errors from the load balancer that never reached a pod.

panels.title: Response time, p95
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. 95% of requests were faster than this.

panels.title: Ingest pods
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Pods reporting each minute, over the last 10 minutes. Nothing is drawn while paused.

panels.title: Search pods
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Pods reporting each minute, over the last 10 minutes. Nothing is drawn while paused.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Share of the instance's CPU.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Usage is what the database needs. Cache is spare memory it can give back. The gap above is free.

panels.title: Disk
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Share of the 10 GB disk.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Built-in metric, a few minutes behind. Open connections to the li database.

panels.title: Lectures ingested
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts ingest_succeeded log lines. Empty unless a lecture was just registered.

panels.title: Ingest failures
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts ingest_failed log lines. No data is the healthy state.

panels.title: Searches
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts successful transcript searches. Listing courses does not count. Empty unless someone just searched.

panels.title: Search failures
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts 5xx responses to searches. No data is the healthy state.

panels.title: Backups succeeded
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts backup_succeeded log lines.

panels.title: Backups failed
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Counts backup_failed log lines. No data is the healthy state.

panels.title: Backup size
panels.description: Log-based metric, a few minutes behind, counting from when it was created. Approximate, because the metric keeps sizes in buckets.

panels.title: Backups stored
panels.description: Azure Monitor metric. Azure refreshes it a few times a day, so it can lag a backup by several hours. For the real list, run make cloud-restore ARGS="list".

panels.title: Storage used
panels.description: Azure Monitor metric. Azure refreshes it a few times a day, so it can lag a backup by several hours. Total size of the stored backups.
